purpose: Teach: 公庫/汎用/中級/勘案/解禁/焼却/税法/公述

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 政策金融公庫の窓口に相談しましょう
lines.en: Let's consult with the Policy Finance Corporation counter.
lines.style: Clear, decisive opening. Brisk tempo — this is a working priority. Confident forward momentum. Crisp consonants on the verbs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。汎用部品で利益率を上げます
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase our profit margins with generic components.
lines.style: Responsive and aligned. Even delivery, slightly formal. Acknowledging and committing in the same breath. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、中級層向け商品も拡充しましょう
lines.en: And let's expand our mid-market product line as well.
lines.style: Purposeful pivot — still directive. The 'and' carries light emphasis. Steady tempo, measured authority. Expectation of agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。顧客の声を勘案した試作品です
lines.en: Yes. Here's the prototype incorporating customer feedback.
lines.style: Prompt confirmation. Professional, slightly formal. Presents the deliverable with quiet competence. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 解禁日のメディア対応、準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the media strategy ready for launch day.
lines.style: Focused and organized. Direct instruction, no ambiguity. Tempo slightly quicker — there's a deadline. Crisp on the key terms.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。機密書類の焼却スケジュールを組みました
lines.en: Yes. I've put together the schedule for destroying the confidential documents.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact completion. Lower tone on the sensitive detail — professional discretion. Steady, responsible pacing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 税法のセミナーに社員を派遣しましょう
lines.en: Let's send staff to the tax law seminar.
lines.style: Continuing the forward motion. Directive but not abrupt. Smooth connection to the previous topic. Expectation of compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の公述案、まとめます
lines.en: Yes. I'll have our public comment statement compiled and ready.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slight sense of closure. Professional, assured. Steady pacing. The word 'ready' carries quiet finality.
